tags: central defender, born in San Patricio, Misiones (Paraguay)

rated the Paraguayan center-back with the best defensive-duel success rate (78.9%) in the past year, ahead of established internationals Omar Alderete, Gustavo Gómez and Fabián Balbuena (Versus.com.py, Feb 2025)
formed at Cerro Porteño (2023-2024: 34 apps, 4 goals), left for CA Lanús (Argentina) where he was quickly called up to the Paraguay senior squad within two months of the move
won the 2025 Copa Sudamericana with Lanús and the 2021 Clausura / 2020 Apertura Paraguayan titles with Cerro Porteño

mental_profile.notes: Family narrative: named 'Ronaldo' by his father after Brazilian striker Ronaldo; was only allowed to leave home for Cerro Porteño's academy at 16 on condition he kept studying sports science (Wikipedia, sourced to Paraguayan press).

off_pitch.family_situation: Publicly reported that his parents required him to continue a sports-science course as a condition of leaving home to join Cerro Porteño's academy at 16.
